name: HDB existing-building source footprints · CENTRAL REGION

metadata.source: HDB Existing Building — Housing & Development Board
metadata.crs_assumption: WGS 84 longitude/latitude (RFC 7946), inferred from GeoJSON coordinates and Singapore bounds; source does not declare a CRS.
metadata.geometry_note: No geometry repair is performed. A simplified display shape is used only when topology and component count are preserved and area change is at most 1%; otherwise the source shape is retained.

simplification.method: Topology-preserving Douglas-Peucker in EPSG:3414; use the simplified shape only if geometry type and component count are preserved and area change is at most 1%; otherwise retain the source shape.
